_doc: Prompt wording for page-aware chat (src/host_context.py): USER MENTIONS guidance and the HOST PAGE CONTEXT block. Describe the action; the model picks the tool from the tool descriptions it was given.
page_guidance: This is what the user sees on the page right now, as of their latest message.
When the user refers to the page, the current view or what they have selected, use these values; they replace any page state mentioned earlier in the conversation.
header: USER MENTIONS (structured — prefer these exact ids; do not guess by filename alone)
file: → If it is not in the chat workspace yet, attach it to the workspace with this artifact_id.
case_with_outputs: → The host loads these into the session data pool / capped file registry (read them from the workspace; do not re-fetch the whole case).
case_without_outputs: → For meaning search inside this case, use a semantic search scoped to this case_id.
→ To bring a case file into the chat, attach it with this case_id plus the filename or artifact_id.
